title: Small-index openness for unrestricted countable permutational wreath products of closed symmetric subgroups with a comeager conjugacy class
author: Bruno Duchesne
work: Topological properties of Ważewski dendrite groups
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.121
difficulty_reason: A small-index subgroup is forced to contain a full supported wreath factor by an infinite disjoint-moiety projection and comeager conjugacy argument. Almost-disjoint continuum families expand it to a cofinite supported factor, leaving finitely many base-group subgroups whose openness closes the proof.
